properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 30 at 8:12PM MST until October 30 at 10:00PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
FFWPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* Until 1000 PM MST.

* At 812 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain has fallen across the warned area, and several
streamflow gauges remain above alarm stage. Between 0.5 and 1.5
inches of rain have fallen. Flooding impacts will continue, but no
additional rainfall is expected. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
New River, Cave Creek and Anthem.

This includes the following highways...
AZ Route 74 between mile markers 23 and 30. AZ Interstate 17 between
mile markers 217 and 226. AZ Route 303 between mile markers 127 and
136.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 30 at 9:02PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Persistent northeast winds and downstream tidal effects on the St
John River are slowing flow at Astor.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards. Homes on
or near Wildhog, Bonnet and Snail roads become inaccessible with
several inches of water inside homes along the river and canals.
Docks at Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely
submerged. Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with
yards completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads
flooded in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on
Juno Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Friday the stage was 3.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Friday was 3.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 3.6 feet.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Saturday afternoon at noon EDT.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 30 at 11:06PM CDT until October 31 at 12:00AM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
SMWLCH

The National Weather Service in Lake Charles has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Cameron LA to High Island TX from 20 to 60 NM...
Waters from Intracoastal City to Cameron LA from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until midnight CDT.

* At 1106 PM CDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over West Cameron
368, or 43 nm east of High Island A80, moving northwest at 15
knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
West Cameron 342 and West Cameron 368.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
